known_limitations: Evidence is bounded by the frozen ContextPackets; a proposition absent from all twenty items of a question's packet cannot be resolved in this phase.
Manual paraphrase and cross-lingual verdicts are human judgements recorded as data; their spans are machine-verified but their FULL/PARTIAL grading is not.
Retrieval expansion was not performed, so RETRIEVAL_GAP candidates are candidates only and no CORPUS_GAP is claimed.
No prose was written and no section was drafted.

retrieval_expansion_policy.permitted_only_for: confirmed RETRIEVAL_GAP on a P0 question with the frozen packet manually exhausted and a recorded justification
